text_block_list.text:
One day, Biwa Hayahide and Narita<n>Taishin are
training hard together.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Phew... There, that makes three sets.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Huh, you been doing more reps or<n>something?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: No, I don't think so. It's the same as<n>always...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
The last time we worked out together,<n>we only ran
three laps. Now you're<n>asking to go for a fourth.
Pretty sure<n>four's more than three.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see. Your confusion must derive<n>from my
description of this workout<n>being "the same as
always."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Lately, my trainer and I have been<n>customizing
workouts based on the<n>condition of my body and
the track<n>instead of depending on set numbers.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Since it's sunny and I feel great<n>today, we
determined that increasing<n>my reps by thirty
percent would more<n>evenly distribute my workload
over<n>the course of the week and—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Ugh, enough. I get it. You can stop<n>now.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You're telling me your trainer has to<n>put up with this
all the time?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I wouldn't say there's any "putting<n>up with" me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
My trainer always takes the time to<n>understand
what I'm saying and lets<n>me know if something is
a good or<n>bad idea.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I value our relationship... very much.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah. Tell me about your littlecrush later. Let's get to work.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I-I do not have a crush! How dare you<n>twist my
words when I was talking<n>about something of
importance!

...It's true that Biwa Hayahide really<n>has grown so
much. Even her friends<n>are picking up on it!
